text: APPROVE. The extracted `MatchesRequested` keeps the same control flow (non-object entries are skipped, an empty or null requested version takes the first object entry, otherwise only an exact `num` string match is returned), and it removes the nested `if`s and `continue`s that drove the complexity up, with no new warning sources such as unused members or nullability problems. I judged this from the diff alone; I did not build it or measure the complexity score.
